lines.t: Verse 1:
I’ve been chasing all the noise again,
Trying to fit where I don’t belong.
They said faith was just pretend —
But I’ve known the truth all along.
You pulled me out when I was fading,
Gave me a fire I can’t fake.
Now every scar is consecrated —
You turned my pain awake.
Chorus:
I’ll stand my ground, I won’t back down,
Your light’s the reason I’m still found.
Even if the world forgets my name,
I’ll shout Your love through every flame.
I’ll shout Your love through every flame.
You made me strong, I’m not ashamed —
I’ll stand my ground.
Verse 2:
I’ve heard the whispers in my head,
Telling me faith’s a losing game.
But I’ve seen the dead hearts come alive —
And I’ll never be the same.
Pre-Chorus:
The dark can roar, but I’m unshaken,
You wrote freedom in my veins.
Every fear has been forsaken —
Your victory remains.
Chorus:
I’ll stand my ground, I won’t back down,
Your light’s the reason I’m still found.
Even if the world forgets my name,
I’ll shout Your love through every flame.
You made me strong, I’m not ashamed —
I’ll stand my ground.
Bridge (angsty but hopeful):
They can call me crazy,
But I’ll still sing loud.
Grace made me fearless,
And I’m not backing out!
Final Chorus:
I’ll stand my ground, I won’t back down,
Your truth’s the fire that can’t burn out.
Even if I fall, I’ll rise again —
You’ve made me brave within my skin.
You made me strong, I’m not ashamed —
I’ll stand my ground.
Outro:
I’ll stand… my ground.
In Your name, I’m found.
Outro:
I’ll stand… my ground.
In Your name, I’m found.
